proposals.name: The Ship-Stair of Keld
proposals.entry:
The Ship-Stair of Keld is the greatest surviving engineering work of pre-war Gravoska.

Two navigable watersheds are separated by an enormous mountain spine. Rather than sail around it, generations of Gravosk constructed a route capable of carrying entire longboats over the mountains.

The Ship-Stair consists of timber ramps, stone channels, flooded basins, counterweights, capstans and hauling stations stretching across the high country. No single portion is particularly sophisticated. Together, they accomplish something extraordinary.

Entire settlements exist to maintain particular stages. Sections have been rebuilt repeatedly over centuries. Gravosk consider this a virtue rather than a flaw.

During the 99 War, the Ship-Stair gives the Gravoska navy a strategic advantage few foreign admirals initially believe possible: a Gravosk fleet can disappear into one watershed and later emerge into another sea.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
One abandoned branch of the Ship-Stair climbs toward a pass that appears on no modern map.

The hauling equipment there is still regularly maintained. Nobody admits doing it.
